PostToolUse.command: cd $(git rev-parse --toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd) && echo '📍 Repo: '$(pwd) && echo '🔗 Remote: '$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || echo 'no remote')
PostToolUse.description: Show current repo after git operations to prevent wrong-repo mistakes

PreToolUse.command: cd $(git rev-parse --toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd) && pwd && git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null
PreToolUse.description: Verify repo identity before commits and pushes
